name: Heleb
title: One of David's mighty warriors
summary: Heleb, son of Baana from Netophah, was one of King David's thirty mighty warriors. He was a distinguished warrior who served in David's elite force and was counted among the most brave soldiers in Israel's united kingdom. His name is mentioned in the lists of David's heroes in 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's thirty heroes
keyEvents.description: Heleb, son of Baana from Netophah, is listed as one of David's thirty mighty warriors who distinguished themselves in service to the king.

keyEvents.title: Listed in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: In the parallel list in 1 Chronicles, he is mentioned as Heled, son of Baana from Netophah, among David's heroes.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's elite force
keyEvents.description: As one of the thirty heroes, Heleb belonged to the inner circle of David's most trusted and skilled warriors who protected the king and led his army forces.

keyEvents.title: Service during David's Kingdom
keyEvents.description: Heleb served faithfully under David's rule as part of the military leadership that secured and fortified the united kingdom of Israel.
